name: 🔁 Forward Tag Remover Bot Source
desc:
🧠 Forward Tag Remover Telegram Bot 🔥
This is NOT a hosted bot, it’s full source code for developers & bot owners.

✨ What this source does 
• Removes “Forwarded from” tag
• Reposts content as original
• Supports text, photo, video, document
• Works with any Telegram channel
• Written in pure PHP
📌 How this bot works

/add @yourchannelusername

name: Telegram Redeem Code Scraper Bot 2026 🔥 | Auto Scan 100+ Channels
